page_title: CAG 0-0 UDI | Cagliari v Udinese 17/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+5' The match has ended for Mateusz Wieteska (Cagliari) as he picks up his second yellow card and referee Daniele Doveri pulls out a red card!
90+4' A nice lofted cross finds Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) unmarked. He takes an excellent touch and gets in a shot that goes towards the middle of the net. An easy save for the goalkeeper, though.
90+3' Neat passing move from Cagliari in order to create new attacking opportunities.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Boris Radunovic is alert and denies him.
90' Mateusz Wieteska (Cagliari) is penalised for holding. Daniele Doveri signals a set piece.
89' Axel Guessand (Udinese) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked.
87' The statistic for corner kicks – 4:6.
85' A player from Udinese brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
82' It is time for a substitution. Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) is on for Florian Thauvin.
81' The linesman makes the right call and Udinese will have a corner.
80' The substitution has been made. Alessandro Di Pardo (Cagliari) has replaced Matteo Prati.
80' Claudio Ranieri decides to make a substitution. Pantelis Chatzidiakos will be replaced by Adam Obert (Cagliari).
80' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Gabriele Zappa as he is replaced by Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari).
78' The ball is crossed into the box and Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the middle of the goal, but Boris Radunovic gets a glove on it to thwart him.
78' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
76' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Hassane Kamara (Udinese).
73' Walace (Udinese) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
72' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Udinese.
72' Festy Ebosele goes off the pitch and Joao Ferreira (Udinese) comes on.
72' Andrea Sottil has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Martin Payero (Udinese) replacing Sandi Lovric.
69' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
68' Udinese take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
67' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) does well inside the box to bring down a pass from Eldor Shomurodov. He gets away a decent shot but it creeps just past the right post.
66' Substitution. Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari) in, Tommaso Augello out.
66' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
65' One of the Udinese players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul.

64' Eldor Shomurodov (Cagliari) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
63' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Florian Thauvin (Udinese) was quite harsh and Daniele Doveri didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
62' Udinese have a corner.
60' Daniele Doveri shows a yellow card to Mateusz Wieteska (Cagliari) for his blatant foul.
60' The game has come to an end for Leonardo Pavoletti. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Eldor Shomurodov (Cagliari).
58' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
56' Festy Ebosele (Udinese) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but the effort is well wide of the left post.
55' Lazar Samardzic whips in the corner and finds Jaka Bijol (Udinese) in space with just the keeper to beat, but somehow he plants his header just over the bar from close in. He should have scored!
54' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
54' The free kick from long range, taken by Udinese, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
53' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) trips an opposition player and Daniele Doveri signals a foul.
52' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
51' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
49' Tommaso Augello sends over an inswinging corner and Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) gets his head on the ball, but it goes just wide of the right post.
49' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
49' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Cagliari.
48' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) serves up a nice cross, but Marco Silvestri punches the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Cagliari are awarded a corner kick.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Enzo Ebosse is replaced by Axel Guessand (Udinese).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+7' The match has reached half-time.
45+7' CLOSE! Florian Thauvin (Udinese) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that goes inches wide of the right post!
45+4' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for a foul after Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) hacks down one of his opponents.
45+2' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) meets a cross inside the box and heads it goalwards. Unfortunately for him, he sends the ball narrowly over the crossbar. What a chance!
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
45' The corner is swung in but Cagliari can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
44' Udinese enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
43' Cagliari are ruled offside.
42' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he fails to change the score as his effort deflects away off the right post.
41' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) beats his man to the lofted pass, but his header sails harmlessly well wide of the right post from close range.
38' Problems for Andrea Sottil as Christian Kabasele (Udinese) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Enzo Ebosse replaces him.
36' Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) commits a rough foul. Daniele Doveri stops the game and makes a call.
34' Festy Ebosele (Udinese) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
34' The Udinese players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
31' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) is adjudged offside.
31' Boris Radunovic is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Lazar Samardzic (Udinese). Easy save!
30' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
29' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
28' The Cagliari players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
27' Nehuen Perez (Udinese) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
25' Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) brings his opponent down. Daniele Doveri has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
24' The referee blows for a cooling break.
22' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
21' The ball is cleared after Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
21' Festy Ebosele (Udinese) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the middle of the target is thwarted by Boris Radunovic.
19' Nehuen Perez (Udinese) leaps highest to meet the resulting set piece and sends his header way off target.
19' The ball goes out of play and Udinese have been awarded a corner kick.

19' Nehuen Perez (Udinese) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. Udinese will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
18' A brilliant through ball from Festy Ebosele (Udinese) as he picks out Nehuen Perez, who darted into free space to take the pass.
17' The free kick from long range, taken by Cagliari, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
17' Nehuen Perez (Udinese) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
16' The game is interrupted now, Nehuen Perez (Udinese) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
15' Jaka Bijol (Udinese) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for an infringement.
12' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) latches onto a lofted pass from Gabriele Zappa on the edge of the six-yard box, but misdirects his header and sends it just wide of the left post.
11' The linesman signals that Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.

10' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
10' The referee signals a corner kick to Udinese.

10' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Udinese will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal. Florian Thauvin (Udinese) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
8' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Cagliari comes to nothing.

8' A through ball from Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) fails to reach Gabriele Zappa as one of the defending players reacts brilliantly to intercept the effort. If the pass had been produced a little bit earlier, Gabriele Zappa could have got into a promising position.
6' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
6' Pantelis Chatzidiakos (Cagliari) plays a terrific long ball forward to Zito Luvumbo, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down.
4' Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) makes a rough challenge and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for a foul.
3' A player from Udinese takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
3' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) and Festy Ebosele combine well with a quick one-two and their attacking move continues.
2' A crossfield pass from Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) fails to find any of his teammates.
2' The Cagliari players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' Nehuen Perez (Udinese) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
1' The first half has started.
Udinese will kick the game off.
Daniele Doveri was nominated as the referee for this game.
